India Post Office GDS Online Form 2026 (23757 Posts) – Last Date – Full Details

Department of Post (India Post) has released the notification for the post of Gramin Dak Sevaks GDS. This recruitment has been issued for 23757 posts. The online application process for India Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 has started on 31 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for India Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Registration Starting Date : 31 August 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 19 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Form Submission Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Pee Payment Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 23-24 September 2026
  • 1st Merit List : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
